Work.title: Selected work
Work.subtitle: Production product work plus personal projects that stretch the stack.

btms.title: BTMS — Business travel platform
btms.summary: End-to-end on the booking product: React (Vite) for air/hotel flows, design-system primitives, and mobile layouts; Quarkus (Java 21) APIs for agency login/lockout, payment cards, company/workspace, passport/customer, and travel AI chat agents; legacy Java/MyBatis services and mappers for hotel settlement, invoices, and HBS→React view cutovers.

hanjaHero.title: Hanja Hero — Korean & TOPIK learning platform
hanjaHero.summary: Web platform for Korean study and TOPIK prep (hanjahero.com): React/Vite client with practice tests and in-question AI explain-answer; FastAPI backend for question explanation, speaking/shadowing scoring, and conversation flows. Shipped explain-answer end-to-end — API design, prompt/service layer, and Question UI integration.

dbViewer.title: DbViewer — MySQL desktop client
dbViewer.summary: Cross-platform MySQL client (Tauri 2 + React + Rust), built with vibe coding — AI-assisted iteration from product plan to MVP: OS-secured connections, object browser, SQL editor with history, virtualized grid, transactional edits, import/export, global search, and ER diagrams.

nhamBlog.title: Nham Blog — MDX publishing platform
nhamBlog.summary: Personal blog and CMS: Next.js App Router, PostgreSQL/TypeORM, MDX editor, admin + writer roles, reader auth (credentials + Google), comments/notifications, Cloudinary media, SEO (sitemap/RSS). Deployed via PM2 and Cloudflare Tunnel with Tailscale-backed CI deploy.

points: Frontend: hotel and overseas air booking in btms-front — search, reservation, payment UI, passport/document validation, mobile, and shared design-system components against Figma.

API v2 (Quarkus): agency auth with lockout/audit, payment-card CRUD, company/workspace/manager APIs, passport & overseas travel handlers, multi-agent air/hotel chat (OpenAI), async email on virtual threads.
Legacy btms (Java/MyBatis/HBS): bookingHotel mappers & settlement/invoice agency flows, IdentificationService password-reset paths, and controller cutovers from Handlebars to React views.

About.title: About
About.body: I'm Tuyen Nham Trieu, a Computer Engineering graduate from Hanoi University of Science and Technology (HUST). As a full-stack software engineer, I work from React/Next.js interfaces to backends in Java, Node.js, or Python — including legacy systems that need steady maintenance. I care about design-aligned UI, clear APIs, and code that's easy to extend.
